Michels, Valentin, Simon De Cannière, Gina Lopez, Maximilian Weigand, Kevin Warstat, Sabine Seidel, Onno Muller, Uwe Rascher, Harry Vereecken, and Andreas Kemna. 2026. “Investigating soil-plant-atmosphere interactions by combining spectral electrical impedance tomography with environmental and physiological timeseries.” (invited). Agrogeophysics Workshop, Lisbon, Portugal.
Michels, Valentin, Simon De Cannière, Gina Lopez, Maximilian Weigand, Kevin Warstat, Bastian Siegmann, Sabine Seidel, Onno Muller, Uwe Rascher, Harry Vereecken, and Andreas Kemna. 2025. “From root to leaf: Multi-sensor monitoring of the soil-plant-atmosphere continuum.” (invited). EGU General Assembly, Vienna, Austria. https://doi.org/10.5194/egusphere-egu25-8723.
De Canniere, Simon, Bastian Siegmann, Valentin Michels, Gina Lopez, Michael Herbst, Andreas Kemna, Harry Vereecken, François Jonard, and Sabine Seidel. 2024. “Monitoring and modelling the diurnal dance between photosynthesis and transpiration.” 4th VOD 4 Forest Workshop, Oberpfaffenhofen, Germany.
Michels, Valentin, Maximilian Weigand, and Andreas Kemna. 2024. “Investigating electrical polarization signatures of sugar beet and maize: A field study using spectral electrical impedance tomography.” EGU General Assembly, Vienna, Austria. https://doi.org/10.5194/egusphere-egu24-16788.
Michels, Valentin, Chunwei Chou, Maximilian Weigand, Yuxin Wu, and Andreas Kemna. 2024. “Quantitative phenotyping of plant roots using spectral electrical impedance tomography.” Agrogeophysics Workshop, Zürich, Switzerland. https://doi.org/10.62329/EXVV3683.
Michels, Valentin, Chunwei Chou, Maximilian Weigand, Yuxin Wu, and Andreas Kemna. 2023. “Rhizotron scale imaging of crop root systems using spectral electrical impedance tomography with optimized measurement configurations.” AGU Fall Meeting, San Francisco, United States.
Michels, Valentin, Maximilian Weigand, and Andreas Kemna. 2022. “Sensing of winterwheat root-systems at the field scale using spectral electrical impedance tomography.” Agrogeophysics Workshop, Brussels, Belgium.
